payload.description_html:
Fish fauna from the Rio Pilcomayo National Park. Per the source, they are listed as:
(1) Potamotrygon motoro;
(2) Steindachnerina brevipinna;
(3) Steindachnerina conspersa;
(4) Psectrogaster curviventris;
(5) Prochilodus lineatus;
(6) Schizodon borelli;
(7) Leporinus lacustris;
(8) Hoplerythrinus unitaeniatus;
(9) Hoplias malabaricus;
(10) Pyrrhulina australis;
(11) Acestrorhynchus pantaneiro;
(12) Serrasalmus maculatus.
